status_at_freeze: R01 exited before creating any job state or running model inference because workers received a relative queue path. R02 changes queue-path resolution only; no prospective seed has been inspected.
amendment_from_r01: Resolve and validate the job TSV as an absolute path before workers change into the CBGBench workspace. Scientific conditions, seeds, budgets, endpoints and analysis remain unchanged.

common_generation_contract.protein_and_ligand_inputs: Reuse the frozen five-pocket CBGBench inputs from gpu-final/cbgbench.
common_generation_contract.evaluator: The same patched CBGBench reconstruction, RDKit QED and favorable normalized SA evaluator used by the completed six-seed experiment.

fixed_best.freeze_basis: TargetDiff ranked first for valid rate and QED in both the three-seed primary and six-seed pooled results.

single_pass.allocation: 500 attempts from each of TargetDiff, Pocket2Mol and DiffSBDD; Gauge ranks the pooled valid candidates once.

iterative.gauge_policy: For each pocket-seed cell, select the generator maximizing 0.50*valid_rate + 0.30*mean_QED + 0.20*mean_favorable_SA. Unique-valid ratio breaks exact score ties, followed by the frozen order TargetDiff, DiffSBDD, Pocket2Mol.
iterative.round_2: Allocate the remaining 750 attempts to the selected generator with seed + 10000.
iterative.stop_rule: Stop after round 2 because the matched 1500-attempt budget is exhausted.

candidate_ranking.primary_summary: Mean score, QED and favorable SA among the top 50 valid candidates per pocket-seed cell.
candidate_ranking.secondary_summary: Valid rate, unique-valid rate, total valid candidates and reconstruction errors.
candidate_ranking.geometry_follow_up: Run the already frozen pocket/clash evaluator on the selected top candidates after the generation manifest is terminal.

analysis.statistics: Report paired cell differences, Wilcoxon signed-rank p-values when defined, and pocket-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals.
analysis.claim_boundary: This tests deterministic, matched-budget model routing and one feedback-driven reallocation step. It does not establish unconstrained molecular refinement or experimental affinity improvement.
